### AI in Nonprofit Fundraising: Key Trends and Practical Uses in 2026

In 2026, AI adoption among nonprofits has surged to 92%, but only 7% report major fundraising impacts, highlighting an "efficiency plateau" where tools save time without fully transforming revenue (Virtuous & Fundraising.AI Benchmark Study [7]). The focus is on practical, ethical applications that amplify human relationships, not replace them. Here's a breakdown based on current data:

#### Top Practical AI Uses
Nonprofits prioritize AI for efficiency in content, analysis, and admin tasks, embedded in CRMs like LiveImpact or Virtuous rather than standalone tools ([1], [2], [6]).

| Use Case | Description | Tools/Examples | Impact |
|----------|-------------|---------------|--------|
| **Content Creation** | Drafts donor emails, appeals, grant narratives, impact reports, and proposals from outlines or past data. Staff review for personalization. | ChatGPT, CRM-built AI (e.g., Virtuous Momentum for outreach drafts) | Saves hours per piece; maintains campaign consistency ([1], [2]). |
| **Donor Data Analysis & Prospecting** | Scores donors for major gifts using giving history, engagement, events, volunteering. Predicts patterns humans take weeks to spot. | CRM AI (LiveImpact), ChatGPT Advanced Data Analysis ($20/mo) | Identifies high-potential prospects; 13% of nonprofits use this ([2], [3]). |
| **Chatbots & Website AI** | Answers donor queries on fund use, eligibility, volunteering. Handles initial engagement. | Tidio (free), LiveImpact AI Smart Search ($19-99/mo), Intercom ($74+/mo) | Boosts average gifts via chatbots to $250 (one-time) or $32 (recurring) vs. industry $115/$24 ([2], [3]). |
| **Personalization & Prioritization** | Daily donor prioritization, personalized outreach drafts, portfolio management. | Virtuous Momentum | Gift officers report better planning and relationship focus ([6]). |
| **Grants & Reporting** | Generates/adapts proposals, logic models; summarizes donor activity for reports. | AI in CRMs or ChatGPT | Aligns with funder guidelines; 23% of foundations reject full AI content ([3]). |

#### Fundraising Trends Shaped by AI
- **Strategic Donor Behavior**: Donors give in fewer, larger amounts; monthly giving drives sustainability. AI helps target these moments ([1]).
- **Transparency Demands**: AI aids real-time impact reporting, now an operational must ([1]).
- **Revenue Boosts**: 30% of nonprofits saw fundraising gains; AI forms lift one-time gifts 40% ($161 avg) and recurring 33% ($32 avg) without PII ([3]).
- **Donor Sentiment**: 67% of online donors support AI in fundraising; 43% see positive/neutral effect on giving, but 31% might give less ([3]).

#### Adoption Stats & Challenges
| Metric | Statistic | Source |
|--------|-----------|--------|
| Overall Adoption | 92% using AI | [7] |
| Major Impact | Only 7% see big capability improvements | [7] |
| Top Reasons | Productivity (35%), marketing (31%), fundraising (24%) | [3] |
| Popular Tools | ChatGPT (57%), Copilot (23%), Gemini (14%) | [3] |
| Barriers | 60% lack expertise; 70% see workload reduction potential but few train staff | [3] |
| AI in Forms/Intelligence | <4% use smart forms; <1% real-time intel | [3] |

#### Ethical Considerations & Getting Started
AI strengthens "heart" in fundraising—91% of funders expect positive impact if human-centered ([4]). Avoid over-reliance: 4.5% of donors research via AI chatbots, but gifts are higher when they convert ([3]). Start affordably:
- **Free/Low-Cost**: ChatGPT for drafts/analysis.
- **CRM-Integrated**: Virtuous, LiveImpact for seamless use.
- **Training**: Courses like "AI & Fundraising" (3-hour) or 2026 AI Certificate emphasize ethics ([5], [3]).

For deeper dives, explore Virtuous' 2026 AI Adoption Report [6] or NPTech-for-Good stats [3]. AI excels at scale, but success hinges on staff guiding it toward donor trust.
